_doc: The Cem bed (story/STORY.md; src/entities/Bioworks.ts): where the supplies you gather are shipped and the Cems build from. worlds: the worlds founded with one (the homeworld; it lies on the free lot of the town nearest the goal building, homeworld.json goal, saved as planet_states.data.town.civic.cembed). It sleeps until the goal (Thales' Printworks) is finished, then the Cems wake and the Printworks' door opens the design menu (stand in it doorDwellMs, or press attack). The bed travels: launching from a world whose Cems are awake, the ship's hold takes a culture of them (replicants.traits.culture); on any other world (not a visit, the ship there) a ghost of the flat waits on the free lot nearest the square, and standing on it seedDwellMs with seed.cost in the store (or pressing attack there) seeds it: the culture breaks open, the Cems take to the salt and the bed is awake at once (planet_states.data.cembed). A seeded bed has a design stone on its rim toward the street (the plinth sprite) that opens the design menu as the Printworks' door does. seed.readoutPx: how near you must be for the ghost to show what it still needs. flat: the salt flat's half width and height (px). mats: how many Cems lie on it. blooms: salt blooms around its rim (items.json salt; saved as nodes bed0, bed1, ...). ants: perTrail ants walk each line between the store and a print and between the bed and a print, at speed px a second, wiggle px to the side; mound ants mill about the mound, forage ants walk between the mound and the bed. fungus: every cleanSeconds a wave of the fungus' light runs over the bed. maxPrints: how many of your designs the Cems build at once (a copy's blueprint they print does not count against it). One building system: where the bed is awake, a copy's approved blueprint, once paid, is printed by the Cems from a voxel model of its footprint, roof and door (src/core/designs.ts blueprintModel), going on from what was already raised by hand; copies tend the bed for every print under way instead (tend.perPrint copies at a time, tend.strokes strokes a visit, each bringing the print tend.ms nearer). alive: how many rows of voxels are still living Cems at the top of a print. hologram: the little turning model over the Printworks' door or the design stone (px per voxel, how often it is redrawn in ms). strain (the tech tree's first step, Steve 2026-10-27): walking among wild Cems on the Cems' world (planets.json wildCems) with the ship there puts a jar of them in its hold (replicants.traits.wild); standing at the door of a finished Biolab with them aboard (dwellMs) changes them into the strain, as Alaina did: this world's bed takes it up (planet_states.data.cembed.strain), the hold's culture carries it (traits.culture.strain) and every awake bed you then walk onto takes it up too. A bed with the strain prints in printTimes of the time and its Cems breathe breath times as fast.
